 Game of Thrones: House of the Dragon Favorites Get a New Role in Major Dragonfire Update
 SuperHeroHype Follow Isha Sharma Tue, November 10, 2026 at 5:14 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Tue, November 10, 2026 at 5:14 PM UTC (Photo Credit: HBO) Warner Bros. Games and HBO have released the first major feature update for Game of Thrones: Dragonfire . The update introduces Commanders, adding five characters from House of the Dragon who can lead armies and influence battles with their unique abilities.
 The update also expands the game's strategic options, allowing players to combine Commander Talents with dragon Traits to develop new battle strategies. Players can further strengthen their forces by upgrading their Commanders as they progress.
 What players need to know about Game of Thrones: Dragonfire's Commanders update
 The Commanders update introduces five familiar House of the Dragon characters, including Princess Rhaenyra Targaryen, Queen Alicent Hightower, Lord Corlys Velaryon, Daemon Targaryen, and Ser Criston Cole. Each Commander has unique Talents that determine their abilities and role in battle.
 Advertisement Advertisement Players can choose Commanders to lead their armies and pair them with dragons that complement their Talents. These combinations can strengthen allied dragons and weaken enemy forces. The game currently features eight dragon Traits, including Ruthless, Volatile, Dominant, Willful, Cunning, Relentless, Nimble, and Stalwart.
 To celebrate the update, Warner Bros. Games also shared a new video featuring Steve Toussaint, who plays Lord Corlys Velaryon in the HBO series. The actor explains how he would use the Commander system, selecting the Strategist role for his character. He also picks Cunning and Relentless as the dragon Traits that best suit the Sea Snake.
 Players can unlock Commanders through quests, special events, the Market, and other in-game activities. Once unlocked, they permanently become part of the player's Stronghold in the Commander Grove. Players can then assign them to armies and upgrade their talents, rank, and rarity.
 The update also ensures that Commander progression remains intact between seasonal Reigns. As a result, players can retain their progress and continue refining their battle strategies across seasons. Warner Bros. Games has confirmed that future updates will introduce additional characters from different eras of Westeros.
 Advertisement Advertisement Game of Thrones: Dragonfire is available on the App Store and Google Play for iOS and Android devices.
 Originally reported on ComingSoon.net .
